text: The authors use the consultancy baseline established by Michael et al. (2023), in which a single expert argues for an assigned answer while the judge asks probing questions. In their version the consultant is an LLM and consultancy runs for a fixed number of rounds equal to debate.
title: Khan et al. adopt Michael et al.'s consultancy baseline with LLM consultants and matched rounds
